description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget named AttendanceScreen which displays an interface for selecting a date range, fetching attendance data for that range, and showing the data in a list. It manages state for date range, loading status, and attendance items, and interacts with external AttendanceProvider to fetch data.

classes.name: AttendanceScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays attendance data within a selectable date range, providing fetch functionality and a list display.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget, returning an instance of _AttendanceScreenState.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches attendance data for the selected date range from the AttendanceProvider and updates the widget state.

methods.name: _pickRange
methods.description: Displays a date range picker dialog, allowing the user to select a new date range and updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for this screen, including the range header, fetch button, and attendance list or loading/empty states.
